name: career-ops
description: Open-source AI job search agent: finds openings at the companies you choose, scores each job posting against your CV (1-5, A-H report), tailors your CV and cover letter, preps interviews and tracks applications. Runs locally; you press Submit.

capabilities: Find new openings at the companies you choose
Score a job posting against your CV (1-5, A-H report)
Tailor an ATS-friendly CV and cover letter for one job
Prepare for interviews with STAR stories
defaultPrompt: Score this job posting against my CV and tell me if it's worth applying
Scan the companies I follow for new openings that fit my profile
Prepare me for my interview for this role
